name: Set Variable
description: Generic Blueprint node generated for each member variable. Writes a new value to a member variable on the target object. Like all Blueprint setters, it is an execution pin node so it can be sequenced between other operations.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.description: The object instance to write to. Hidden when accessed from 'self'. Connect an actor/component reference to write a variable on it.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.description: The new value to assign to the variable. Type matches the variable's declared type. Connect a literal, math result, or another variable.

outputs.name: Out
outputs.description: Execution pin that fires after the variable is assigned. Continue the graph from here.
